name: VirtualKeyboard
src_typeComment: Touch-friendly on-screen keyboard for kiosks with no physical keyboard — routes key presses into a TMP_InputField by editing its text/caret directly. Drives a pre-built grid of KeyButtons rather than generating layout at runtime, matching this toolkit's existing UI-component convention (ToastNotification/ ModalDialog/DraggableUIPanel all drive author-time-built UI, not runtime-generated) — build the actual QWERTY/numeric layout once via DemoSceneBuilder or the Inspector, reuse it everywhere.

src_serialized.name: target
src_serialized.tooltip: The input field this keyboard types into. Can also be set at runtime via Bind().

src_members.sig: public void Bind(TMP_InputField newTarget) => target = newTarget
src_members.name: Bind
src_members.comment: Rebinds which input field this keyboard types into — e.g. a login screen's username/password fields sharing one on-screen keyboard, rebinding on each field's OnSelect.

src_members.name: InsertText
src_members.comment: Public (not just wired internally) so a self-test — or a project's own custom key layout — can drive text insertion directly without needing a real KeyButton click.

src_members.sig: public void Submit() => OnSubmit?.Invoke(target != null ? target.text : string.Empty)
src_members.name: Submit
